SELECT stu.id student_id, cou.id course_id, stu.student_name, stu.students_phone, bcls.id class_id, cou.course_name, bct.total_number, bct.remaining_number, max( template.send_time ) send_time FROM bd_student_class bsc left join bd_student stu on bsc.student_id = stu.id LEFT JOIN bd_class bcls ON bsc.class_id = bcls.id LEFT JOIN bd_course_time bct ON bsc.student_id = bct.student_id and bct.course_id = bcls.class_course_id left join bd_course cou on bcls.class_course_id = cou.id AND bct.course_id = bcls.class_course_id LEFT JOIN bd_template_message template ON bct.course_id = template.course_id AND template.student_id = bct.student_id WHERE bsc.is_delete = 0 AND bct.is_delete = 0 AND bsc.mec_id = #{mecId} AND bsc.campus_id = #{campusId} AND bct.remaining_number < 6
and stu.student_name like concat('%',#{studentName},'%')
and cou.course_name like concat('%',#{courseName},'%')
GROUP BY bct.id ORDER BY bct.remaining_number

SELECT bs.student_name, bs.id student_id , GROUP_CONCAT(bcl.class_name) class_names, GROUP_CONCAT(bco.course_name) course_names FROM bd_student_class bsc JOIN bd_student bs ON bs.id = bsc.student_id AND bs.is_delete = 0 AND bs.is_ordinary = 0 JOIN bd_class bcl ON bcl.id = bsc.class_id AND bsc.is_delete = 0 JOIN bd_course bco ON bco.id = bcl.class_course_id AND bsc.is_delete = 0 WHERE bsc.mec_id = #{mecId} AND bsc.campus_id = #{campusId} AND bsc.is_delete = 0
AND bcl.class_name like concat('%',#{className},'%')
AND bco.course_name like concat('%',#{courseName},'%')
GROUP BY student_id
mapper.update: UPDATE bd_course_time SET remaining_number = remaining_number - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND remaining_number >= 1
UPDATE bd_course_time SET remaining_number = remaining_number + #{delta}, total_number = total_number + #{delta}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bd_course_time SET total_number = #{num}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND #{num} >= remaining_number
UPDATE bd_course_time SET remaining_number = remaining_number + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bd_course_time SET remaining_number = remaining_number - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND remaining_number >= 1
